units.source: Screenshot of Zen Mode activated on a Windows 11 system with native title bar off and background effects on.
When Zen Mode is activated (pictured on the side), most of the user interface of Trilium is hidden away in order to be able to focus on the content, whether it's for reading or writing.
Screenshot of the Zen Mode option in the global menu.
The Zen Mode can be activated by accessing the global menu and selecting the “Zen mode” option:

Aside from the global menu, it's also possible to activate this mode by using a keyboard shortcut (which is __TRILIUM_PH_0__F9__TRILIUM_PH_1__ since TriliumNext 0.92.5 and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Alt__TRILIUM_PH_3__+__TRILIUM_PH_4__Z__TRILIUM_PH_5__ for older versions). Look for __TRILIUM_PH_6__ in the shortcut configuration.

Once Zen Mode is activated, all the UI elements of the application will be hidden away, including the global menu. In that case, the Zen Mode can be deactivated either by pressing the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ icon in the top-right corner of the window or by pressing the keyboard combination again.
Do note that, by design, activating or deactivating the Zen Mode applies only to the current window. Restarting the application will also disable the Zen Mode.

units.context: Zen mode > Moving the window around

units.source: If “Native title bar” is activated, then the operating system's default title bar can be used to drag the window around. If deactivated, the window can still be moved by dragging the mouse across the top part of the window where the note titles are.

Zen mode > Split windows and tabs

units.source: Tabs are completely hidden, however it's still possible to use keyboard shortcuts such as __TRILIUM_PH_0__ (__TRILIUM_PH_1__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_2__+__TRILIUM_PH_3__1__TRILIUM_PH_4__ by default), __TRILIUM_PH_5__ (__TRILIUM_PH_6__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_7__+__TRILIUM_PH_8__2__TRILIUM_PH_9__ by default). There are also some newer shortcuts such as __TRILIUM_PH_10__ (__TRILIUM_PH_11__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_12__+__TRILIUM_PH_13__Tab__TRILIUM_PH_14__) or __TRILIUM_PH_15__ (__TRILIUM_PH_16__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_17__+__TRILIUM_PH_18__Shift__TRILIUM_PH_19__+__TRILIUM_PH_20__Tab__TRILIUM_PH_21__) that allow easy navigation, however make sure that they are configured properly in the settings.
units.context: Zen mode > Split windows and tabs

units.source: For the split view of notes, there are no keyboard shortcuts at the time of writing, but it's still possible to have them in Zen Mode by creating the split while the Zen Mode is off and then reactivating it afterwards.
